resident_license_available.quote: A resident or nonresident license issued under this chapter shall be issued under the license types described under Subsection (2).

business_entity_license_available.quote: An insurance organization shall be licensed as an agency if the insurance organization acts as: (1) a producer;

designated_licensee_required_for_busines.quote: An agency shall designate an individual that has an individual producer, surplus lines producer, limited line producer, consultant, managing general agent, or reinsurance intermediary license to act on the agency's behalf in order for the licensee to do business for the agency in this state.

temporary_license_available.quote: The commissioner may issue a temporary individual or agency license: (i) to a person listed in Subsection (1)(b) ... (B) for a period not to exceed 180 days; and (C) without requiring an examination;

temporary_license_max_days.quote: for a period not to exceed 180 days; and (C) without requiring an examination;

appointment_required_to_represent_insure.quote: An insurer shall appoint an individual or agency with whom it has a contract as an insurance producer, limited line producer, or managing general agent to act on the insurer's behalf in order for the licensee to do business for the insurer in this state.
appointment_required_to_represent_insure.citation: Section 115 - Appointment of individual and agency insurance producer, limited line producer, or managing general agent.

fiduciary_duty_for_funds.quote: a licensee is a trustee for money that is paid to, received by, or collected by a licensee for forwarding to insurers or to insureds.

rebates_prohibited.quote: a producer, consultant, or other licensee under this title, or an officer or employee of a licensee, may not induce a person to enter into, continue, or terminate an insurance contract by offering a benefit that is not: (i) specified in the insurance contract; or (ii) directly related to the insurance contract.

misconduct_reporting_to_department_days.quote: for an administrative action, within 30 days of the final disposition of the administrative action; or (II) for a criminal prosecution or civil action, within 30 days of the initial appearance before a court;

financial_institution_insurance_sales_re.quote: A person authorized to engage in insurance activities in this state shall prominently disclose in writing the information described in Subsection (1)(b) to a person seeking an extension of credit if: (i) the person authorized to engage in insurance activities also extends credit directly or through a subsidiary or an affiliate;

conditional_loan_insurance_tying_prohibi.quote: A person may not restrict in the choice of an insurer or licensee under this chapter, another person who is required to pay for insurance as a condition for the conclusion of a contract or other transaction or for the exercise of any right under a contract.

manager_exclusive_general_agent_license_.quote: A person, firm, association, or corporation may not act in the capacity of managing general agent with respect to risks located in this state for an insurer licensed in this state unless the person is a licensed producer in this state.

naic_producer_database_used_for_verifica.quote: The commissioner may verify a producer's licensing status through the producer database maintained by: (a) the National Association of Insurance Commissioners; or (b) an affiliate or subsidiary of the National Association of Insurance Commissioners.

home_state_change_application_window_day.quote: a person licensed as one of the following in another state who moves to this state shall apply within 90 days of establishing legal residence in this state:

lapsed_license_reinstatement_window_days.quote: A licensee whose license lapses may request reinstatement of the license and line of authority no more than one year after the day on which the license lapses.
lapsed_license_reinstatement_window_days.citation: Section 113 - License lapse and voluntary surrender.

fingerprint_submission_required.quote: A person, if required to submit to a criminal background check under Subsection (3)(a), shall: (i) submit a fingerprint card in a form acceptable to the department; and (ii) consent to a fingerprint background check by: (A) the Utah Bureau of Criminal Identification; and (B) the Federal Bureau of Investigation.
fingerprint_submission_required.citation: Section 105 - General requirements for individual and agency license issuance and renewal.
